description: (Outer Urban PT) Public transport services per hour during 2017 weekday off peak is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Infrastructure Australia. This is part of analysis from Outer Urban Public Transport, which was released in October 2018. This layer presents public transport stop frequency during weekday off peak (11am-12am). This analysis was performed using 2017 public transport timetables. See pages 80-81 of the report for a detailed explanation of methodology. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Infrastructure Australia. Its tags are public transport, transport. It offers 5 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP, SLD, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
